summary: Frontend-only test of Professional Directory feature as approved pro (approval.test.pro1@gmail.com). All functional flows pass: dashboard professionals-section renders with heading 'Available Professionals', count '5 approved colleagues', 4 compact preview cards, professionals-view-all-btn navigates to /professionals; action-professionals card present (5 primary action cards total: accept-invite, family-matters, invite-parents, joint-reports, professionals). /professionals shows 5 cards, verified badges on Joy Curbow, Albert W. Smith, Matt Sossi, and approval.test.pro2 (4 badges total); own card shows '(you)' and NO refer button; email mailto: links present. Search 'Curbow' filters to 1 card (Joy Curbow, MS). Refer flow: dialog opens with 5 matter options, message input works, POST /api/professionals/{id}/refer returns 200, toast 'Referral sent to Albert W. Smith, PhD' shows, dialog closes. ONE CRITICAL DESIGN BUG: at 390px viewport, /professionals AND /dashboard have massive horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=862 vs 390). Root cause: pro-card cells expand to ~838px because their parent grid lacks a base grid-cols-1.

issues: Horizontal overflow of 472px (scrollWidth=862 vs viewport=390). Every pro-card renders at width ~838px on mobile, breaking the 'no horizontal overflow' acceptance criterion for this feature.

RCA: In Professionals.jsx line 116 the grid uses `grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4` and in ProfessionalsPreview.jsx line 25 `grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4` — both missing a base `grid-cols-1`. Without grid-template-columns set, CSS Grid falls back to auto-sized implicit tracks, so cells stretch to fit their widest child (the VerifiedBadge 'CREDENTIALS VERIFIED' at 187px + min-w-0 content). Fix: add `grid-cols-1` to both grid classes.

When VerifiedBadge is present the name is aggressively truncated (e.g. 'Albert ...', 'Joy Cur...', 'Approv...', 'Matt So...') because the 187px 'CREDENTIALS VERIFIED' badge eats most of the row width in a narrow 3-col cell. Consider a shorter badge label (icon + 'Verified') or stack badge under the name.

action_items: Add `grid-cols-1` to the base of the two grids: Professionals.jsx line 116 (`grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4`) and ProfessionalsPreview.jsx line 25 (`grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4`). This is the single fix that removes the mobile horizontal overflow on both /professionals and /dashboard.
Optional: shorten VerifiedBadge label to 'Verified' or move badge to a second line so professional names aren't truncated to 4-6 chars in 3-column desktop view.
critical_code_review_comments: Professionals.jsx and ProfessionalsPreview.jsx use `grid` Tailwind class without a base column count. On viewports narrower than sm (640px), no grid-template-columns is set, so CSS Grid uses implicit auto-sized tracks that stretch to content width — this is why pro-cards balloon to ~838px at 390px viewport. Always pair `grid` with a base `grid-cols-{n}`.

ProfessionalCard: badge shrink-0 combined with `min-w-0` name div still lets the badge consume ~187px in narrow desktop 3-col cells, forcing name truncation to a handful of characters. Consider hiding the 'CREDENTIALS VERIFIED' text on smaller cell widths or stacking below the name.

rca of the issue: Mobile overflow RCA: Tailwind's `grid` utility only enables `display: grid` — it does NOT set columns. In Professionals.jsx (line 116) and ProfessionalsPreview.jsx (line 25) the classes read `grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4` (and `lg:grid-cols-4`). Below the sm breakpoint (640px), no `grid-template-columns` rule applies, so the grid falls back to a single implicit auto-sized track. That track sizes to the widest child, and each ProfessionalCard's row `<div class='flex items-start justify-between gap-2'>` contains a `min-w-0` name column plus a `shrink-0` VerifiedBadge (~187px 'CREDENTIALS VERIFIED' label), producing an ~838px card in a 390px viewport → 472px horizontal overflow. Fix: add explicit `grid-cols-1` at the base breakpoint in both files. Verified same overflow occurs on /dashboard because ProfessionalsPreview is rendered there.
